data.title: 若叶睦 · 收好的蓝丝带
data.description: 她把散开的蓝丝带卷好，放回小盒子。盒盖合上之前，睦确认了发夹也在里面。
data.action: 把蓝色丝带放进收纳盒
data.camera: 中景，收纳盒和丝带清晰
data.promptProse: At a backstage dressing table, Mutsumi gently coils a deep blue satin stage ribbon and places it into a dark lacquered trinket box. Glowing vanity mirror bulbs illuminate her quiet expression and reflect jars of hairpins across the wooden surface.
data.animaCaption: Tucking the rolled blue ribbon into its wooden box compartment, she closes the lid with a soft, solemn motion.
